description: Write the narrative for one or more horizons. Send a key per stage: { "NOW": { title, narrative, doneWhen } }. This writes the STORY only — which clusters sit in a horizon is set by anyforge_update_theme status, the single place that can change. Requires `write` scope.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_set_horizon_narrative
title: Set horizon narrative
